rv.q: Anna X meets Sally Rooney in Honor Santa Barnes’s latest solo show. What does it take to break into the art world? Merely a new identity. A chance encounter in a busy toilet on a night out changes a young woman’s life. She decides she’s going to make it big by any means necessary.
Minor gripes aside Ms HSB has the chutzpah to deliver a yarn with confidence albeit the material would benefit from a slower and clear narrative arc.

Under Elle Blackwood’s controlled direction and Ellie Wintour’s simple, movement-friendly set, the strength of Barnes’ performance shines through, and she maintains an incredibly fresh performance style throughout. Her accent work in particular is an impressive feat and it’s clear this is someone to watch.
It is funny, disarming, and occasionally disturbing, and is certainly helped by Honor's personable performance...

cn.t: Critics find Florence a mixed but intriguing solo show. Honor Santa Barnes earns praise for her energised performance, though the piece divides opinion on its overall impact.
